items.title: What should I share first?
items.text: Describe the result you need, the property location, and what you know about access or existing utilities.

items.title: Can you estimate a project from photos?
items.text: Photos can help start a conversation, but the business must explain what can be assessed remotely and what needs a site visit.

items.title: Who confirms permits and utilities?
items.text: State the actual coordination process and who is responsible for each approval before work begins.

items.title: Does a project brief book the work?
items.text: No. It organizes information for a conversation. Scope, price, availability, and scheduling require direct confirmation.
